articles.title: One dead as Iranian missiles strike wealthy Gulf
articles.summary: Al Udeid, a crucial US military base, hosts forward elements of CENTCOM, including air and special operations forces. Last June, Iran fired missiles at the base. This incident occurred following a preceding US strike, highlighting regional tensions and the volatile strategic environment in the Middle East and the critical role of such bases.

articles.title: HC defers Delhi government's directive for private schools to form fee-regulation committees
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court has deferred the Delhi government's mandate for private schools to constitute 'School Level Fee Regulation Committees' (SLFRCs) for the upcoming academic year. This decision postpones the establishment of these committees, initially aimed at regulating school fees, providing temporary relief to private schools and impacting parents awaiting clarity on educational costs.

articles.title: Abolish ICE? Absolutely — and DHS too
articles.summary: The article discusses the internal debate within the Democratic Party regarding the abolition of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). It addresses concerns that even if ICE were abolished, existing immigration statutes would remain, necessitating broader policy changes beyond simply dismantling the agency. This highlights a significant political challenge for the party concerning immigration reform.

articles.title: Israel and US attack Iran, sparking retaliatory strikes. Here's what we know
articles.summary: Amid escalating tensions and a US military buildup in the Middle East, Israel initiated strikes early Saturday morning. This action follows weeks of anticipation regarding potential attacks on Iran. Israel's move marks a significant escalation in regional instability, impacting international relations and security. SSB aspirants should closely monitor these geopolitical developments for current affairs awareness.

articles.title: Trump’s risky public health charade rings hollow
articles.summary: Denmark's Arctic Command recently conducted a rescue mission for an American crew member needing urgent medical attention. The successful evacuation by the Joint Arctic Command underscores vital international cooperation and operational readiness in the challenging Arctic region. This humanitarian effort highlights the importance of interoperability among forces for critical operations in remote environments, a key aspect for defence aspirants.

articles.title: Strait of Hormuz on edge due to Iran-Israel war? Iran’s leverage is a cautious tale for India
articles.summary: The decades-long shadow war between Israel and Iran, previously fought through proxies and clandestine attacks across land, sea, air, and cyberspace, has now escalated into open confrontation. This marks a critical shift in the Middle East, demanding a thorough understanding of historical geopolitical tensions and potential regional implications. articles.title: Barcelona vs Villarreal – Match preview and team news
articles.summary: Barcelona and Villarreal are set to face off in a highly anticipated LaLiga match at Camp Nou on Saturday. Barcelona aims to solidify its position at the top of the league table against third-placed Villarreal. This crucial encounter will impact the title race in the Spanish football league, drawing global attention to the contest.

articles.title: Iran strikes back, targets US military in Qatar, Kuwait, UAE, Bahrain
articles.summary: The Iranian military reportedly launched attacks on four US military sites across Qatar, Bahrain, Kuwait, and the United Arab Emirates. This move was declared as retaliation for alleged joint US-Israeli strikes conducted against targets within Iran. Such actions signify a critical escalation of military tensions in the Middle East, underscoring complex regional power dynamics crucial for global security analysis.
